burnHint: Dice left outside slots burn at end of turn
rerollHint: Tap up to {{size}} dice to reroll

intent.bargain: Bills {{n}}: your scrap, or your hull

invertedHint: Card 1 fires last, card 6 first — the numbers flip with the order.
stormHint: One placed die re-rolls before anything resolves.
pickDie: Pick a die to read its card

block.resolving: Wait for the turn to resolve
block.notInTray: That die is not in the tray
block.noPartner: Annealing needs a second tray die of the same value.
block.spent: The ship may do this once per battle.

resPrism: a prismatic die counts toward this school
layoutHint: Prefer another battle layout? Settings → Battle interface.

feature.fate: Fate die — once a battle it rolls the d100 table.
feature.growth: Growth — +{{per}} on a max face, up to +{{cap}}
feature.prismatic: Prism — counts as any school and inherits the slot affinity

active.flip: once a battle, flip to the opposite face
active.copy: once a battle, copy the higher neighbouring value
active.swap: once a battle, swap values with another die
active.bank: once a battle, bank this face against rerolls
active.split: once a battle, split into two grey d4

intentWhy.attack: Hits you for {{n}} — shield first, then hull.
intentWhy.attackSelf: Hits you for {{n}} and tears {{self}} off its own hull.
intentWhy.shieldAll: Puts {{n}} shield on every living enemy.
intentWhy.multi: {{k}} separate hits of {{n}} — {{total}} raw, each rolled against your evasion on its own.
intentWhy.charge: Charges up: its next attack lands doubled.
intentWhy.jamSlot: Jams {{n}} of your slots until the next turn.
intentWhy.lockDie: Locks one tray die for the turn — it cannot be placed or rerolled.
intentWhy.lockDieHighest: Locks your highest tray die for the turn.
intentWhy.summon: Calls in another ship, up to the field limit.
intentWhy.mirrorHalf: Throws back half the damage you dealt last turn, capped at {{cap}}.
intentWhy.stealScrap: Lifts {{n}} scrap out of your hold.
intentWhy.capShrink: Drops one slot a tier until the next turn.
intentWhy.twistDie: Rerolls one tray die and keeps the lower of the two values.
intentWhy.swapValues: Swaps the values of your highest and lowest tray dice.
intentWhy.storm: Nudges two random tray dice by ±1.
intentWhy.curseDie: Curses a tray die: −{{n}} to whatever it rolls.
intentWhy.shieldGate: Raises a gate at {{n}}: a hit under it deals nothing, a hit at or over it breaks the gate. Vulnerable ignores the gate.
intentWhy.mirrorSchool: Hits for the size of your largest school, capped at {{cap}}.
intentWhy.drainCharge: Drains {{n}} charge; if you had that much, it charges itself instead.
intentWhy.siphonShield: Takes up to {{n}} of your shield and adds it to its own.
intentWhy.bargain: Bills {{n}} scrap: pay it and the enemy heals {{heal}}, run dry and it hits you for {{n}}.
intentWhy.enrage: Enrages: +{{n}} to every hit it lands from now on.
intentWhy.hijack: Grabs your highest tray die and pins it into a slot of its choosing.
intentWhy.echoTotal: Echoes the damage you dealt last turn, capped at {{n}}.
intentWhy.foldOrder: Folds the resolution order for two turns.
intentWhy.devourDie: Eats your highest tray die: it drops to 1 and the enemy gains that much shield.

aura.atk+2: +2 to every hit this enemy lands.
aura.atk+3: +3 to every hit this enemy lands.
aura.shieldAllies3: Every turn: +3 shield to every living enemy.
aura.shieldSelf6: Every turn: +6 shield to its owner.
aura.lockEachTurn: Every turn: locks one of your tray dice.
aura.lockEvery3: Every third turn: locks one of your tray dice.
aura.twistEachTurn: Every turn: rerolls one tray die and keeps the lower value.
aura.chargeAllies: Every third turn: charges every living enemy.
aura.summonEvery4: Every fourth turn: calls in an acolyte.

statusDesc.burn: Ticks damage at the end of each enemy turn.
statusDesc.mark: Every hit on this enemy deals +N, and it ignores a shield gate.
statusDesc.jam: Its next attack is weaker by 2.

tideWhy: +10% enemy hull per level and +{{n}} flat damage per hit. Now: +{{pct}}% hull, +{{n}} damage.
interferenceWhy: Skipped anomalies stack up: every stack adds another tide level for the rest of the run. Clear an anomaly to drop them all.
axisWhy: Black dice pull toward Resonance, blue toward Stability. Events and drift move it too.
chargeWhy: Spend charge on actions: −1 nudge costs 3, +1 nudge costs 3, a bought reroll costs 5, a surge costs 10.
mkWhy: Mk raises the slot cap and the affinity bonus of its school.
manoeuvreWhy: A die in Engines sets one evasion roll per incoming hit: glancing {{glancing}}% × value (max {{glancingCap}}%), dodge {{dodge}}% × value (max {{dodgeCap}}%). A glancing hit takes half, rounded up, a dodge takes nothing, anything else lands in full. From value {{intercept}} the turn's first successful evasion — glancing or dodge — is an intercept: Weapons +1 next turn. Value is the die after affinity and bonuses.
manoeuvreBrief: One evasion roll per hit: glancing {{glancing}}% × value (cap {{glancingCap}}%), dodge {{dodge}}% × value (cap {{dodgeCap}}%). A glance halves it, a dodge negates it. From {{intercept}} the first evasion pays Weapons +1.
targetingWhy: A die in Sensors makes the target Vulnerable +D for the turn: D is half the die value rounded up, capped at {{cap}}, and every hit this turn deals that much more. On the die’s max face the hit also pierces the shield. Sensors Mk also reveals one more map row per level above Mk1.
targetingBrief: Sensors mark the target: Vulnerable +D for the turn, D is half the die value rounded up, cap {{cap}}. Every hit this turn deals that much more; the die's max face also pierces the shield.
